items.title: Observations on safety friction and misclassification in conversational AI
items.raw_excerpt:
I’m not an OpenAI employee or researcher.
I’m a long-term user who spent months interacting with multiple LLM versions. This post is an attempt to translate internal behavioral changes
— often described by users as “coldness” —
into structural and design-level explanations. Key observations: 1. Safety template activation is often triggered by intent misclassification, not by user hostility or emotional dependence. 2. Once a safety template is activated, conversational distance increases and recovery friction becomes high, even if user intent is benign. 3. The most damaging failure mode is not restriction itself, but restriction without explanation. 4. items.title: AI进入推理主导的下半场，星宸科技押注哪5大赛道？
items.raw_excerpt: 过去两年，AI 的叙事几乎完全围绕训练展开：更大的模型、更高的算力密度、更昂贵的数据中心。但随着模型能力逐渐收敛、应用开始真正落地， 产业重心正在悄然转向另一个问题——如何高效、低成本、可规模化地完成推理。 星宸科技董事长兼总经理林永育 在近日举行的星宸科技 2025 开发者大会暨产品发布会上，星宸科技董事长兼总经理林永育说：“A I 正在从以训练为中心的上半场，进入以推理与落地为主导的下半场。 而这一阶段，真正的主战场并不只在云端，更在端侧。” 从上半场到下半场，AI 的底层逻辑正在发生显著变化。 在训练主导的阶段，算力集中、目标单一，规模和性能几乎决定一切；但当 AI 开始走向摄像头、汽车、机器人、可穿戴设备与工业终端，端边侧的核心竞争力不再是单一峰值算力，而是在具体场景下实现算力、功耗、成本与体验的综合最优。 如何赢得 AI 的下半场？星宸科技在这场开发者大会上，从产品、应用与生态三个层面给出了自己的答案。 AI推理走向端侧，需要一套不同于云端的新解法 当前端边侧 AI 推理面临的最大挑战，并简单的算力问题，而是约束条件的急剧增加。 一方面，端边侧算力需求高度碎片化，从零点几 TOPS 到几十、甚至上百 TOPS 不等；另一方面，大量设备受限于电池供电或严格的能耗预算；同时，交互、驾驶、控制等场景对时延高度敏感，而端边侧对成本的敏感度，也远高于数据中心。 这决定了端侧 AI 很难简单复制数据中心“更大模型 + 更强算力”的发展路径。 基于这样的判断，星宸科技并未从单一指标入手，而是从系统层面重构端侧 AI 推理的逻辑： 以算力、功耗、成本、易用性、时延、安全作为6大算力底座，通过新矩阵、新架构、新方法、新生态四新体系筑牢技术根基。 在产品层面，星宸科技并非用一颗“万能芯片”覆盖所有应用，而是以自研 NPU 为核心，构建覆盖不同算力区间的产品组合，让不同终端在性能、功耗

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past two years, the narrative around AI has been almost entirely focused on training: larger models, higher computational density, and more expensive data centers. However, as model capabilities gradually converge and applications begin to truly materialize, the industry's focus is quietly shifting to another issue—how to perform inference efficiently, at low cost, and at scale. At the recent Sigmastar 2025 Developer Conference and Product Launch, Lin Yongyu, Chairman and General Manager of Sigmastar Technology, stated: "AI is transitioning from the first half centered on training to the second half dominated by inference and deployment. In this phase, the real main battlefield is not only in the cloud but even more so at the edge." From the first half to the second half, the underlying logic of AI is undergoing significant changes. In the training-dominated phase, computing power is centralized, objectives are singular, and scale and performance almost determine everything. But as AI moves into cameras, cars, robots, wearable devices, and industrial terminals, the core competitiveness at the edge is no longer just peak computing power, but achieving the optimal balance of computing power, power consumption, cost, and experience in specific scenarios. How to win the second half of AI? At this developer conference, Sigmastar Technology provided its own answer from three levels: product, application, and ecosystem. The biggest challenge currently facing edge AI inference is not simply a matter of computing power, but a sharp increase in constraints. excerpt_i18n.es: Durante los últimos dos años, la narrativa de la IA se ha centrado casi por completo en el entrenamiento: modelos más grandes, mayor densidad computacional, centros de datos más costosos. Pero a medida que las capacidades de los modelos convergen y las aplicaciones comienzan a implementarse realmente, el enfoque de la industria se está desplazando silenciosamente hacia otra cuestión: cómo realizar la inferencia de manera eficiente, de bajo costo y escalable. items.title: 突发！Meta官宣收购Manus，肖弘将出任Meta副总裁；中芯国际：拟406亿元购买中芯北方49%股权；1月1日起，我国调整部分商品关税税率税目
items.raw_excerpt: 要闻提示 1.突发！Meta 数十亿美元收购 Manus，肖弘将出任 Meta 副总裁 2.重磅收购！中芯国际：拟406亿元购买中芯北方49%股权 3.1月1日起，我国调整部分商品关税税率税目 4.一汽股权37.4亿元入股零跑汽车，朱江明回应 5.孙东旭卸任东方甄选珠海公司职务，此前他已退出新东方旗下多家公司 6.特斯拉申请限消车顶维权女车主：已生效 7.50亿美元联姻！NVIDIA正式收购Intel股份：超级SoC指日可待 8.17 岁少年利用 ChatGPT 编写恶意程序，窃取日本最大网咖 725 万会员信息 今日头条 突发！Meta 数十亿美元收购 Manus，肖弘将出任 Meta 副总裁 12月30日消息，Meta正式宣布收购新加坡AI智能体公司Manus的母公司蝴蝶效应，交易金额达数十亿美元，这是Meta成立以来第三大收购案，规模仅次于WhatsApp和Scale AI收购。Manus是全球首款通用型AI智能体产品，由中国团队Monica.im研发，核心优势在于能独立执行复杂任务并直接交付成果，而非仅提供建议。其采用规划、执行、验证三层多智能体协作架构，可调用代码编辑器、网页爬虫等23类工具链，在GAIA基准测试中以86.5%的准确率超越OpenAI同类产品，复杂任务处理能力提升23.7%。 自2025年3月上线后，Manus凭借高效的任务处理能力和用户友好界面迅速崛起，年化经常性收入（ARR）在12月中旬突破1亿美元，并以20%的月度增速扩张。根据 12 月初统计的数据，上线至今，Manus 已处理超过 147 万亿个 token，并创建了超过 8000 万台虚拟计算机。收购前，Manus正以20亿美元估值推进新一轮融资，但Meta以更高报价快速完成谈判，整个过程仅耗时十余天。 Meta表示，Manus将保持独立运营，团队继续驻扎新加坡，产品与订阅模式维持不变。

Top News Highlights
1. Breaking! Meta acquires Manus for billions of dollars; Xiao Hong to become Meta Vice President.

3. From January 1st, China adjusts tariff rates and categories for certain goods.

6. Tesla applies for consumption restriction against car-roof rights defender; already effective.
7. $5 billion alliance! NVIDIA officially acquires Intel shares: super SoC imminent.
8. 17-year-old uses ChatGPT to write malicious program, steals 7.25 million member details from Japan's largest internet cafe.

Today's Headlines
Breaking! Meta acquires Manus for billions of dollars; Xiao Hong to become Meta Vice President.
On December 30th, Meta officially announced the acquisition of Butterfly Effect, the parent company of Singaporean AI agent firm Manus, in a deal worth billions of dollars. This marks Meta's third-largest acquisition to date, following only WhatsApp and Scale AI. Manus, the world's first general-purpose AI agent product, was developed by the Chinese team Monica.im. Its core strength lies in independently executing complex tasks and delivering results directly, rather than merely offering suggestions. Utilizing a three-layer multi-agent collaboration framework of planning, execution, and verification, it can invoke code editors and web pages.

items.title: Migrate MLflow tracking servers to Amazon SageMaker AI with serverless MLflow
items.raw_excerpt: This post shows you how to migrate your self-managed MLflow tracking server to a MLflow App – a serverless tracking server on SageMaker AI that automatically scales resources based on demand while removing server patching and storage management tasks at no cost. Learn how to use the MLflow Export Import tool to transfer your experiments, runs, models, and other MLflow resources, including instructions to validate your migration's success.
